{{Leo}}
Leo 18 is the 242nd day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 18th day of Leo, and it is a Thursday. It corresponds to ISO week 35, weekday 4.

Its informal Japanese name is 9宮18日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 242|Chapter 242]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152262}}.
